comments.author: lankyboi2k9
comments.body_html: I broke something . I equipped a weapon from my rack and then pulled it off to mod causing an error that then stopped me from doing anything like buying from traders, entering the hideout or moving things inside my stash. reloading my profile and deleting the weapon fixed it but I thought you might like to know. The error in the console was something to-do with SEVwhite but i didnt safe it sorry.

comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html:
This mod doesn’t change anything to do with actually equipping (And definitely doesn’t touch un-equipping) weapons. It just changes what weapons are listed in the quick equip menu, but base BSG code handles the actual equipping, and it handles pulling from the rack fine.

I’m assuming something went wrong with some other mod, but without the error I wouldn’t be able to look into it either way

comments.author: lankyboi2k9
comments.body_html: yeah using the quick equip menu I selected a weapon from my rack and then moved it to my stack which is what caused the issue. I can see how this is just a problem with the game and not your mod so I will just be careful not to do the same again.

comments.author: Gintaras
comments.body_html: Hello, I wanted to ask, I installed your mod but when I go into the game and press F12 (BepInEx\plugins) your mod is not in the list. And what should your mod do in the game?

comments.author: DrakiaXYZ Staff
comments.body_html:
This mod has no configuration (As the description says).

This mod allows you to select weapons from your hideout weapon rack in the quick-equip menu for weapon slots, when you click the label above a weapon on your inventory screen.
